🎥🎬: Rick and Morty (2013- present)

Genius but reckless scientist Rick Sanchez returns to live with his daughter’s family and pulls his nervous grandson Morty into endless adventures across dimensions, planets, and alternate realities. Armed with a portal gun and limitless curiosity, Rick drags Morty into bizarre situations that challenge the laws of science and reality itself.

As the duo explores the universe, they encounter alien civilizations, alternate versions of themselves, and dangerous threats while dealing with the complicated bond between a brilliant but troubled grandfather and his innocent grandson.

#RickAndMorty #AdultAnimation #SciFiComedy #Multiverse #AnimatedSeries
